vision.paraphrase: Drawing the pages finished each month is the third goal.

conops.paraphrase: chart writes the HTML file the reader named.

vision.paraphrase: A chart the reader can read needs each bar named and valued.

conops.paraphrase: Each bar is labelled with the month and its pages.

vision.paraphrase: Local and private: the chart loads nothing from anywhere else.

conops.paraphrase: The page opens in a browser from the local file alone.

requirements.rationale: Whether a picture is readable cannot be asserted by a test; a person opens the page and looks.

vision.paraphrase: A glance is enough: a person judges whether the chart reads well.

conops.paraphrase: Bars are tall in proportion to the pages, with nothing overlapping.
